config.needsofnature.cpm.description.int: NoN can render your active CPM model during animations. Models using CPM's standard player parts usually work automatically, including additional geometry attached to those parts.
config.needsofnature.cpm.description.pro: Models using your Minecraft skin use the normal NoN destroyed-skin and mess files. Custom-textured models require a matching CPM texture profile. Use %s to generate correctly sized editable files without replacing existing edits. %s updates only the copied model texture.
NoN can render your active Figura or NoFigura avatar during animations. Simple avatars attached to standard player body parts usually work automatically. More complex humanoid avatars may require additional compatibility setup.

Use %s for avatars with custom textures. It creates editable templates for destroyed-skin and mess effects and adds standard split-limb mappings. The avatar must be unpacked into a folder before NoN can update it.

Enable this if scripted transforms cause body parts to remain in a standing pose or become disconnected during animations. NoN will control the detected humanoid parts while an animation is playing. This preference is saved separately for each avatar.

On a compatible NoN server, avatars and Figura pings are synchronized locally through that server. Local synchronization takes priority. Official Figura cloud synchronization is optional and is only used when local synchronization is unavailable.
Most avatar scripts, dynamic textures, visibility changes, and NoN Lua values continue to update during animations.
Use %s to access the active avatar. For packed avatars, it opens the main Figura avatars folder instead.
config.needsofnature.offsets.description: Offsets fine-tune actor positions when a custom model or resized character does not match the standard player proportions an animation was created for.
During an animation, press %s to open the offset editor. Use its buttons, or scroll over a value, to adjust it.
Applies only to the selected actor role in the current animation.
Applies to the current model in every animation.
Model-wide and animation-role offsets are combined.
When enabled by the server, an opted-in advanced controller can add a separate role-based offset of up to two blocks to any actor. Personal offsets remain intact.
Use offset profiles to keep separate adjustments for different models or player sizes. Figura can store personal offsets in the active avatar; advanced offsets remain in the portable profile.
